To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) we have developed a computational approach for discovering cis regulatory motifs directly from whole genome sequence data; 2) we have applied the approach to the yeast genome and discovered a highly organized network of regulatory motifs and coregulated promoters; and 3) the algorithm should scale to much larger genomes.
